name: tvbs-skills
description: TVBS AI Team's open-source Claude Code agent skills — reusable productivity tools installable via Claude Code Plugin Marketplace.

plugins.name: my-wiki
plugins.description: Personal HTML report bookmark wiki powered by Cloudflare Worker + R2 + KV. Guides first-time setup and lets you publish HTML reports from any project with a single command.

plugins.name: team-wiki
plugins.description: Team HTML report wiki powered by Cloudflare Worker + R2 + KV. Multiple teams share one Worker; each team sees only their own members' reports, with per-author filtering and cross-member deletion. Zero Trust protected.

plugins.name: tvbs-trends
plugins.description: Query the TVBS Google Trends system — rising keywords, news opportunity detection (exclusive scoops / urgent follow-ups), topic scans, keyword momentum, and historical snapshots. Uses the npm CLI (npx @tvbs-ai/tvbs-trends@latest) with personal sign-in; REST as fallback.

plugins.name: elasticsearch-master
plugins.description: Elasticsearch best practices for TVBS projects — index versioning, alias management, mapping design, semantic search, ingest pipelines, and zero-downtime deployment.

plugins.name: ai-champion-tech-stack
plugins.description: TVBS AI Champion team's approved technology stack — guides agents toward tools and platforms already in use so new projects stay consistent with existing infrastructure.

plugins.name: company-wiki
plugins.description: TVBS company HTML report wiki (wiki.tvbs.ai): connect Claude Code / Codex with one browser approval, write readable reports, then publish, search, organize, trash and restore them, and manage teams and members — anything the web can do.

plugins.name: html-report
plugins.description: Turn an answer, research result, comparison or incident review into one readable HTML report: the agent writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled CLI lays it out with diagrams, charts and light/dark themes, producing a single offline file ready for the company wiki. Recommended companion of company-wiki.

plugins.name: roomcord
plugins.description: Configure and manage AI agents on RoomCord (WorkCord is RoomCord for Enterprise) — room agents, custom agents, skills, schedules, and API credentials — with your own login through the workcord CLI.
